description.value:
Using predictive algorithms and minor divinations, runic lenses transmit information at a rapid pace to the parietal lobe of your brain, helping you avoid danger.

Activate—Track Movement 1 (concentrate)

Frequency once per 10 minutes

Effect Choose up to 2 creatures within 60 feet that you can see. Your predictive eyes track that creature to give you split-second predictions of its actions. Until the end of your next turn, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to AC and Reflex saving throws against attacks and effects from that creature. If you have the Anticipate Danger class feat, this bonus applies to your Perception DC when you Anticipate Danger.
